scope: Non-operational computational analysis of public longitudinal SARS-CoV-2 measurements; no pathogen engineering, wet-lab protocol, clinical recommendation, or treatment claim.

meta_registry_transfer.core_question: Does the saliva-versus-nasal measurement relation depend on which side of the within-person nasal viral-load peak the infection trajectory occupies?

target.time_coordinate: Time = days since lowest nasal CN value, as documented by source code

already_seen: dataset schema and source boundary encodings
not_computed_before_freeze: any post-result prior-art search for this exact observable

observable.reason: Any subject-independent constant assay offset cancels in the pre/post difference. H=0 is mirror compatibility of the relative compartment relation at that offset.
observable.eligibility_per_offset: same subject has unique uncensored nasal and saliva measurements at exact Time=-d and Time=+d; Nasal_CN<48 and Saliva_Ct<47 on both sides; no interpolation
observable.duplicate_rule: ambiguous duplicate subject-Time keys excluded, never averaged

primary_hypothesis.statement: A reproducible positive cross-compartment mirror hysteresis emerges on early symmetric offsets around the nasal peak.
primary_hypothesis.direction: median H(d)>0, corresponding to saliva being relatively more virus-rich before the nasal peak and/or nasal being relatively more virus-rich after the peak.
primary_hypothesis.first_break: smallest d with n_matched>=10, median H(d)>=2.0 Ct-units, and two-sided exact sign-test p<=0.01 against median zero.
primary_hypothesis.anti_cherry_pick: Negative H of equal magnitude is a directional MISS, not a relabeled discovery.

global_hysteresis_summary.A: sum over eligible d=1..7 of median H(d) for offsets with n_matched>=10; reported regardless of first-break verdict
global_hysteresis_summary.role: secondary magnitude summary only; cannot rescue a failed first-break.

null_control.analytic: two-sided exact sign test on H_i(d); random pre/post label exchange is exactly a sign-flip null
null_control.additional_deterministic_permutation: 10000 subject-level random sign flips of each subject's complete H-vector using seed 33033; compute max over eligible offsets of median H(d).

frozen_terminal.PASS: directional first-break criterion passes and familywise permutation p<=0.01
frozen_terminal.FAIL: all eligible offsets have median H<=0 or familywise p>0.05, or a robust opposite-direction first-break passes equivalent magnitude/sign-test criteria
frozen_terminal.EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: fewer than 10 matched subjects at every offset or intermediate results

if_PASS: post-result exact prior-art killer search for cross-compartment viral-load hysteresis / phase-dependent same-load relations
independent high-frequency multi-compartment cohort replication without retuning
show material consequence for state representation or sampling interpretation
